summary.name: DeepLearning.AI
summary.one_liner: DeepLearning.AI is an online education platform, founded by Andrew Ng, offering courses and professional certificates in AI engineering.
use_cases: build AI agents and LLM apps
get a step-by-step AI learning path
stay current with AI research and tools
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes online AI courses and professional certificates aimed at building AI engineering skills, including agents, apps, and LLM-powered features. Courses are described as hands-on and not tied to any one tool or model. A free tier lets users watch every course video and join a community, while a Pro membership adds hands-on coding labs, practice quizzes, industry-recognized professional certificates, and exclusive courses with Andrew Ng. The site also offers a questionnaire that builds a personalized learning path and a newsletter on AI research, tools, and courses.
notable: Founded by Andrew Ng; courses taught by volunteer experts
Personalized step-by-step learning path based on goals and experience
Pro membership adds coding labs, quizzes, and certificates
caveats: Pro membership features (labs, certificates, exclusive courses) require a paid tier
Page does not state Pro pricing
